Type:

Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> aes3_dt_ref;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined aes3_dt_ref
(aes3_data_type reference) 3 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype AAF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00...0x07 : valid
0x08...0xFF : not used
For transmission, if format is set to a value which represents a AES3 stream data encapsulation
the middleware shall set value of aes3_data_type_h to the configured value, if it is not provided
by the application.
Visibility:
protected
